summary: Requested a third configuration point for the startup-replay boundary. The account states that the replay can enqueue at most 128 batches, so the entry limit is 128 times MaxAppendEntries, and it has been supported at batch sizes 64 (8192 entries) and 1024 (131072 entries). The new experiment sets MaxAppendEntries to 1, where the predicted boundary is only 128 entries, and seeds a commit-tracking store with exactly 128 entries in the control and 129 in the trigger, with the staged commit index at the entry count and no snapshot. A local probe matched the prediction exactly: the 128-entry control returned in under a millisecond, while the 129-entry case never returned within five seconds, left one goroutine inside processLogs and applied nothing. Three comparisons cover the control's return, the trigger's failure to return, and the expectation that a completed replay would have applied all 129 entries. The harness also records the batch count per case so the three configuration points can be compared directly. The submission validates with zero schema errors and requests one execution.
